type: Developer-run synthetic cases, one model response each; not user research or proof of reduced disputes.

cases.request: Design a two-sided cafe menu with revisions. Deliver print-ready files by Friday.
reviewFor: Print file specifications and printing responsibility
included: Menu design for both sides of a single sheet
needs: Restaurant name and branding (logo, colors, fonts if applicable)
Dietary information or special notes to include
File format specifications (PDF, AI, INDD, etc.)
Cafe contact details or hours if to be included

questions.prompt: How many revision rounds are included? What types of changes count as revisions?
Which Friday? What time is the deadline, and what timezone?
What file format do you need (PDF, native design file, both)? Are there specific print specifications (resolution, color mode, bleed settings)?

cases.request: Build a five-page website with a booking form and ongoing support.
reviewFor: Inquiry form versus live booking and availability
Duration and boundaries of ongoing support
excluded: Ongoing support scope, duration, and response times
Third-party integrations beyond the booking form
needs: Page structure and purpose of each of the five pages
Booking form requirements and data fields

questions.prompt: What does 'ongoing support' include? For example: bug fixes, feature requests, updates, email responses, response time guarantee, or duration (months/years)?
What should each of the five pages contain? (e.g., Home, Services, About, Contact, Booking confirmation—or different pages?)
What information must the booking form collect, and where/how should bookings be stored or confirmed?

cases.request: Make a logo with revisions and all the source files. Need it ASAP.
needs: Design style preferences (modern, minimal, playful, corporate, etc.)
Logo usage context (web, print, social media, etc.)
Preferred source file formats (AI, PSD, Figma, etc.)

questions.sourcePhrase: revisions and all the source files
questions.prompt: How many revision rounds are included? Are unlimited revisions expected?
What is the specific deadline? (ASAP is unclear and may cause disputes)
What is the logo for? What style, industry, or design direction do you prefer?

cases.request: Create social posts with images for our launch.
excluded: Designing or creating images from scratch
needs: Images (provided by customer or source identified)
Target social media platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.)
Tone and messaging direction for launch
Key details about what is being launched
Any brand guidelines or style requirements

questions.prompt: Will you provide the images, or do you need the freelancer to source/create them?
Which platforms should the posts be written for, and how many posts do you need?
What is being launched, and what are the main messages you want to communicate?
